kinds.name: Agate
kinds.look: Drab brown, grey or black outside; often covered with small half-moon chips under 1 cm across; can be pitted.

kinds.name: Jasper
kinds.look: Red, yellow, brown or green; rhyolite-margin jasper is "usually too fractured" (Bonnichsen).

kinds.name: Obsidian
kinds.look: Black to brown glass with a shell-shaped (conchoidal) break and razor edges; float pieces are often frosted or sand-etched (Lange 1965, Ore Bin 27(4)).
